traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria from docs/stories/022.0-DEV-JSDOC-COEXISTENCE.story.md are satisfied: - Traceability annotations work before, after, and interleaved with other JSDoc tags via the updated valid-annotation-format rule and isNonTraceabilityJSDocTagLine helper. - The parser correctly terminates multi-line @story/@req values at any non-traceability JSDoc tag line and only continues values on non-tag lines, fulfilling REQ-ANNOTATION-TERMINATION, REQ-JSDOC-BOUNDARY-DETECTION, and REQ-CONTINUATION-LOGIC. - Tests explicitly tied to all listed requirements for this story exist in tests/rules/valid-annotation-format.test.ts and pass in the current Jest run, confirming no false positives and preserved multiline behavior. - Documentation for the valid-annotation-format rule has been updated with a dedicated JSDoc coexistence section and examples showing valid positions of traceability annotations relative to other JSDoc tags. Given the concrete implementation changes, passing tests, and documentation updates, this story is fully implemented and passes.
